doc.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Hired by Gladys Hampton; two years, tours and bandmates
summary: Gladys Hampton reluctantly hired him; he stayed about two years touring Australia, Europe and Canada alongside Julian Priester, Wilbur Hogan, Oscar Dennard and the Williams trumpeters.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: She was that way with everybody.
How long did you stay with Lionel Hampton?
United States tour? Overseas tour? Both?
We didn’t do any of the tours for the government. We toured overseas, just normal tours: Australia, Europe, Canada, everywhere.
Who were your bandmates at that time?

Julian Priester was there – trombonist Julian Priester. Wilbur Hogan, the great drummer. Oscar Dennard, fantastic piano player from Memphis, with all the great piano players that come from Memphis. There were quite a few. Eddie Williams, a great
trumpet player, and Richard Williams, a fantastic trumpet player. He had a lot of good jazz players in the band. The band was really good.
